subject: general
question: There are two pipes to fill a tank. Together, they can fill the tank in 15 minutes. If one pipe can fill the tank in one and a half times as fast as the other, the faster pipe alone can fill the tank in:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of efficiency of faster pipe to slower pipe = 1.5 : 1 = 3 : 2.

Total combined efficiency = 3 + 2 = 5 units/min.

Total capacity of tank = Combined efficiency × Time = 5 × 15 = 75 units.

Time required by faster pipe alone = Total capacity ÷ Faster pipe efficiency = 75 ÷ 3 = 25 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 25 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by both pipes together = 15 minutes.

Faster pipe fills 1.5 times as fast as the slower pipe.

**Method Used:**

Total Work = Combined Efficiency × Time Taken

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the efficiency of the slower pipe be 2 units/min.

⇒ Efficiency of the faster pipe = 1.5 × 2 = 3 units/min.

⇒ Combined efficiency of both pipes = 3 + 2 = 5 units/min.

⇒ Total Work = Combined Efficiency × Combined Time

⇒ Total Work = 5 × 15 = 75 units.

⇒ Time required by faster pipe = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of faster pipe

⇒ Time = 75 ÷ 3 = 25 minutes.

**∴ The correct answer is 25 minutes.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes & Cisterns

If a pipe can fill a tank in x hours, its efficiency (part filled in 1 hour) is 1/x. For an outlet pipe emptying the tank in y hours, its efficiency is −1/y.

Efficiency & Time Relationship

Time taken to complete a work is inversely proportional to the efficiency. Ratio of Time = 1 ÷ Ratio of Efficiency.

Combined Work Formula

When two pipes working together take times A and B respectively, their combined time T is given by T = (A × B) ÷ (A + B).
